info.name: Juniper Networks Juniper Apstra Intent-Based Networking Alarms NAT API
Juniper Networks List source NAT rules

items.docs: Returns all source NAT rule sets and rules. Source NAT translates the source IP address of outbound traffic for internet access or address hiding.

info.name: Juniper Networks List destination NAT rules

items.docs: Returns all destination NAT rule sets and rules. Destination NAT translates destination addresses for inbound traffic to internal server addresses.
